ground_truth_witness: Let V₀=Qₚ{x,y,z} and F be the free metabelian Lie algebra, graded by bracket length. Set r=ad(x)([x,y])=[x,[x,y]]∈gr₃(F), and define L̄=F/(Sym̂(V₀)·r). Take v=x and a=[x,y]∈gr₂(L̄). Then a≠0, while ad(v)(a)=r=0.
ground_truth_flaw: For either stated construction of the metabelian Lie algebra \overline{L}, every nonzero v\in V_0 induces an injective map \ad(v):\gr_i(\overline{L})\to\gr_{i+1}(\overline{L}) for all i.
